notes.title: Vanildo's Journey is now Free to Play!
notes.notes:
For those who followed the wonderful community event [i][b]Made in Brazil[/b][/i], the news just came out that Vanildo's Journey has become free to play!

After almost 2 years since the original game's release, it was already planned to make it free on today's date. However, it happened in the middle of the community event, which could create a very unpleasant situation for those who purchased the game in the last promotion.

So, I'm here to let you know: You can rest assured!

I'm very grateful to everyone who supported the project from the beginning, who purchased the game in its earliest versions when it was still very raw and with little content. Today, almost 2 years after release, we want Vanildo's message to reach more and more people, being accessible to everyone and spreading its word! 🙌✨

For all who purchased the game between May 2022 and February 2024, you will soon receive the rewards of [i][b]Vanildo's Journey Legacy Edition[/b][/i], exclusively available to those who obtained the game before it became free to play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41808237/069a57f69ebb34d5c0c367f61fd8180adeb6648c.png[/img]

I also take this opportunity to thank all the content creators who helped promote the game before and during the event.

May this be just the beginning of this [i][b]journey[/b][/i]!

Thank you all! ✨💖

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41808237/551554aa939ad02e43075df80da49543a1be2a16.jpg[/img]

notes.title: BIG Update on Vanildo's Journey!
notes.notes:
Months after the official launch, we gathered feedback from many players to improve Vanildo's Journey to a new level! Now more polished and optimized, the game brings changes in line with major community requests.


[u][b]Patch Notes:[/b][/u]
[i]
- Improved game interface and menus.
- New ways to configure the keyboard, allowing you to play in WASD mode or the way you want.
- Optimization of overall game performance.
- New game mechanics.
- Visual changes in different stages.
- New scenarios.
- New in-game arts.
- Remake on Boss Fight.
- Change in items and equipment.
- Late Game Balancing.
- New art and wallpapers for the Fan Pack.
- Fixed bugs and performance issues.
- Spell correction (English version).
- New sound effects.
- New scenery objects.
- Unreleased scenes and moments.
- New in-game interactions.
- Changes to in-game branches and choices.
- Improved additional options.
- Adjustments and improvements to existing branches.
- Fixed item drop.
- New narrative elements.[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41808237/9dc94aaef257c25b449ae15a9d4398d48a0ecac0.png[/img]

notes.title: Full controller support! 🎮
notes.notes:
Vanildo's Journey game has been adapted and tested for today's main controls, working with full compatibility! The use of controls can bring a dynamic and comfortable experience to users who like this style of game, expanding the horizons of Vanildo's Journey even more!

There are several different types and models of controls, so we ask users who use less conventional controls to, if possible, send us feedback if the experience is up to par. All support is welcome! 🌙

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41808237/7577a21742bda43cb29f2cefac6b02a96a5c3e86.png[/img]

notes.title: English version available now!
notes.notes:
Game 100% translated into English! Linguistic and cultural adaptations were made, which is not just a translation, but a reinterpretation to better adapt to the non-original language.

Bug fixes, technical tweaks, visual remakes and general balancing were also made for this release!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41808237/7577a21742bda43cb29f2cefac6b02a96a5c3e86.png[/img]
